dispatch.body:
Integration preparation dispatch for existing M6 wN lanes — 2026-11-03.

Maintainer (verbatim): “so, is work continuing across all lanes?”
Factual correction: all five workers were done/available after T46 completion verification. Root had updated the milestone but had not dispatched the next work. This dispatch starts the finite integration inputs below; it does not reopen completed audits.

Root keeps planning, final acceptance, merge order, live merges, pin changes, runtime allocation and tracker changes (D-WORKFLOW-189; plan §§6b/8). The source-reading order is complete; the accepted branches still require ordered integration. All workers read this FULL comment, #346 and applicable current rules, then perform only their named deterministic extraction/comparison. No worker chooses a roadmap, disposition, replacement baseline or merge resolution.

Common immutable anchors: coordinator 71bee11968b8a2f3b0165004f21c5498a47a6054 in /workspace/repos/pixelelated/distribution.worktrees/m6-renovation-plan-346; distribution next 8ebaf8daad8eaac6331dff6fc048fb4411d7decb (fresh remote read agrees); P1 2174265e9cc1b248c0fbe27fa101875984d46d6b. Use absolute git -C for immutable reads; do not switch or alter your accepted worktree. Small private text/JSON/TSV/scripts under a newly owned /tmp directory only. No complete source-tree export/clone, git object/ref writes, simulated/live merge, fetch, producer/test/lint/scanner replay, config sourcing, cache/archive/held/proof-root reads, cleanup, runtime/provider/host-ledger/device/cloud action or other-agent approval answer. CPU8–23 throughout. Preserve historical identity, original failure/evidence limits and accepted decisions. Missing/ambiguous inputs stay explicitly unresolved rather than inferred.

P1, m6-p1-survey wN:p3 — delivery manifest:
From all46 current owning issue bodies #648–#693 and canonical slices.json at the coordinator anchor, produce exactly46 ordered integration-input rows. Columns: k/canonical ID/area/issue/state; literal reviewed-at/execution-seed/fixed-at and ES equivalents; exact source/body reference for each field; accepted source tip versus later completion tip separately; local immutable object existence and ancestry-to-pinned-next. Use existing coordinator handoff and named completion readbacks for the later T39/T41/T42/T43/T44/T46 completion refs. For a missing or contradictory field, inspect only the latest explicitly relevant acceptance/handback comment and mark still-unresolved; never substitute a moving branch head. Do not rerun inventory/status/drift or audit source. Output the machine-readable manifest plus finite unresolved-field list. Root will consume it to bind integration commands.

T1, m6-t1-os-launch wN:p4 — doctrine/source overlap inputs:
Read full #651/#685/#686/#693 and their literal accepted ref fields, with T39 accepted4eb5/completion7994 and T46 accepted17a/completiondf805 as already verified. Derive metadata-only three-way path comparisons among these four accepted doctrine/records source deltas, pinned coordinator and pinned next. Scope excludes historical audit/QA/research/day-log bodies and binary bodies. For every current instruction/tool/reference source path changed by these accepted slices, report base/accepted/coordinator/next mode/type/blob/size, identical/equivalent/competing edit classification and exact generating refs. Retain T39's48 known corrections rather than re-reviewing them; reuse its accepted bridge. Separate source paths from shared ledger entrypoints; report ledger path identities only. No semantic audit or resolution choice. Root uses this input to preserve accepted corrections while combining doctrine.

T2, m6-t2-es-launch wN:p5 — ES integration source intersections:
Read the full owning interface issue bodies for T2/T18/T20/T21/T26/T31–T36/T44 (#649/#665/#667/#668/#673/#678–#683/#691). Use literal accepted ES refs, with read-only object access through /home/max/Development/emulationstation-next.worktrees/m6-es-vendored-and-data-691. Produce exact changed-path mode/blob metadata and pairwise intersections among accepted ES deltas; use ES survey/base16dbac5211eea7e70db7394372033be2be7df829 only as the explicit base comparison, not a selected merge target. M7's distribution1850362563dc02720f1910faa415ed96580fa7d2 is not an ES commit; its recipe names this base, while its carried patch overlay is outside this bounded task Distinguish existing ancestor incorporation, byte-identical convergence and genuinely different blobs. Catalogue overlaps must preserve the known35PO/37files/38replacement and French companion facts as accepted context, without parser replay. T44 remains a read-only accepted source, not another remediation delta. No source bodies/export, held patches, source fix, ES mutation or integration decision. Return the concrete intersection inputs the root needs for the ES composition sequence.

T3, m6-t3-emulators wN:p6 — remaining closure-evidence matrix:
From the46 current slice issue bodies, extract every currently unchecked criterion exactly, and the explicit pending-image/pin/guest/held/integration conditions already named in those bodies. This is a literal tracker extraction, not a new verdict. Key each row by issue, criterion ordinal, exact text/body hash and existing named evidence/owner reference. Separate literal runtime requirement from literal records/integration requirement; label ambiguous text unknown. Do not reopen audit bodies, read held content or decide that any criterion is satisfied. Preserve #693's17/1 distinction. Produce the finite matrix for the root's eventual integration verification and runtime request; no new runtime is authorized.

T5, m6-t5-build-engine wN:p7 — distribution source intersections:
Read full owning issue bodies for T1/T3/T5–T17/T19/T22–T25/T27–T30/T37/T40–T43/T45 (#648/#650/#652–#664/#666/#669–#672/#674–#677/#684/#687–#690/#692). Derive accepted reviewed-at to fixed-at net source metadata, excluding audit/QA/research/session/worklog bodies, then exact intersections with pinned coordinator/next and among those accepted source deltas. Identify file identities and ancestry only; inherited/coordinator changes remain labelled as net-diff context, never inferred lane authorship. Source-free table slices stay explicit no-product-delta rows; open input gaps are not new fixes. No recipe evaluation, compilation, source body sweep, accepted tests or resolution choice. Return the finite source collision inputs for root-controlled distribution merges.

Return one substantive result or precise early blocker to wN:p2, then stop at this bounded preparation boundary. Do not wait for another lane's result: the five products are disjoint views of the same pinned source/tracker contract, and root joins them. These artifacts feed the next concrete integration brief; they are not five repeated audits. No new project, milestone, audit or source-remediation slice is created.

Can this be done on the VM? These are immutable Git metadata and tracker-record comparisons, with private metadata outputs only; no runtime behavior is claimed or required. Root separately verifies the current M7/next ownership gate and prepares the actual serialized roll-up. The historical #640 checkout-move condition does not authorize moving any checkout now.

Pre-delivery factual correction, 2026-11-03: the first draft mistakenly called1850362563 an ES anchor. Root's immutable read identified it as a distribution commit in the legacy repository, whose literal ES PKG_VERSION is16dbac5211eea7e70db7394372033be2be7df829. The T2 task above now names the base correctly and excludes any inferred M7 overlay/composition. No worker had been prompted and no merge target was selected.
